name: mint-for-mac
description: Smart disk and memory for you and your agents. Mint knows what Cursor, Claude Code and Codex leave behind, from conversations to worktrees that can be made again, old builds and simulator copies, and which idle apps hold memory. Cursor's agent gets space and RAM back through Mint's checks; anything that deletes for good, quits an app or changes settings waits for you in Mint.
